source.note: Official DBE November 2023 Mathematics P2 marking guidelines (English/Afrikaans). Bilingual PDF; English transcribed only.

extraction.method: transcription from the official PDF text layer, checked against 140 dpi page renders

notes:
If a candidate answers a question TWICE, only mark the FIRST attempt.
If a candidate has crossed out an attempt of a question and not redone the question, mark the crossed-out version.
Consistent accuracy applies in ALL aspects of the Marking Guidelines. Stop marking at the second calculation error.
Assuming answers/values in order to solve a problem is NOT acceptable.

Geometry mark types used in this memo:
- S: a mark for a correct statement (a statement mark is independent of a reason).
- R: a mark for the correct reason (a reason mark may only be awarded if the statement is correct).
- S/R: award a mark if statement AND reason are both correct.

parts.working_md:
$\mathrm{LHS}=\dfrac{\cos^4 x+\sin^2 x\cdot\cos^2 x}{1+\sin x}$

$=\dfrac{\cos^2 x\bigl(\cos^2 x+\sin^2 x\bigr)}{1+\sin x}$

$=\dfrac{\cos^2 x}{1+\sin x}$

$=\dfrac{1-\sin^2 x}{1+\sin x}$

$=\dfrac{(1-\sin x)(1+\sin x)}{1+\sin x}$

$=1-\sin x$

$=\mathrm{RHS}$

alternatives.label: OR
alternatives.working_md:
$\mathrm{LHS}=\dfrac{\cos^4 x+\sin^2 x\cdot\cos^2 x}{1+\sin x}$

$=\dfrac{\cos^4 x+(1-\cos^2 x)\cos^2 x}{1+\sin x}$

$=\dfrac{\cos^4 x+\cos^2 x-\cos^4 x}{1+\sin x}$

$=\dfrac{\cos^2 x}{1+\sin x}$

$=\dfrac{1-\sin^2 x}{1+\sin x}$

$=\dfrac{(1-\sin x)(1+\sin x)}{1+\sin x}$

$=1-\sin x$

$=\mathrm{RHS}$

alternatives.label: OR
alternatives.working_md:
$\mathrm{RHS}=1-\sin x$

$=(1-\sin x)\times\dfrac{1+\sin x}{1+\sin x}$

$=\dfrac{1-\sin^2 x}{1+\sin x}$

$=\dfrac{\cos^2 x}{1+\sin x}$

$=\dfrac{\cos^2 x(\sin^2 x+\cos^2 x)}{1+\sin x}$

$=\dfrac{\cos^4 x+\cos^2 x\cdot\sin^2 x}{1+\sin x}$

$=\mathrm{LHS}$

$\sin(A-B)=\cos\bigl[90^{\circ}-(A-B)\bigr]$

$=\cos\bigl[(90^{\circ}-A)-(-B)\bigr]$

$=\cos(90^{\circ}-A)\cos(-B)+\sin(90^{\circ}-A)\sin(-B)$

$=\sin A\cos B+\cos A(-\sin B)$

$=\sin A\cos B-\cos A\sin B$

alternatives.label: OR
alternatives.working_md:
$\sin(A-B)=\cos\bigl[90^{\circ}-(A-B)\bigr]$

$=\cos\bigl[(90^{\circ}+B)-A\bigr]$

$=\cos(90^{\circ}+B)\cos A+\sin(90^{\circ}+B)\sin A$

$=-\sin B\cos A+\cos B\sin A$

$=\sin A\cos B-\cos A\sin B$

parts.working_md:
$\dfrac{\sin 3x+\sin x}{\cos 2x+1}$

$=\dfrac{\sin(2x+x)+\sin(2x-x)}{\cos 2x+1}$

$=\dfrac{\sin 2x\cos x+\cos 2x\sin x+\sin 2x\cos x-\cos 2x\sin x}{2\cos^2 x-1+1}$

$=\dfrac{2\sin 2x\cos x}{2\cos^2 x}$

$=\dfrac{2(2\sin x\cos x)\cos x}{2\cos^2 x}$

$=\dfrac{4\sin x\cos^2 x}{2\cos^2 x}$

$=2\sin x$

alternatives.label: OR
alternatives.working_md:
$\dfrac{\sin 3x+\sin x}{\cos 2x+1}$

$=\dfrac{\sin(2x+x)+\sin x}{2\cos^2 x-1+1}$

$=\dfrac{\sin 2x\cos x+\cos 2x\sin x+\sin x}{2\cos^2 x}$

$=\dfrac{2\sin x\cos x\cos x+\cos 2x\sin x+\sin x}{2\cos^2 x}$

$=\dfrac{\sin x\bigl(2\cos^2 x+\cos 2x+1\bigr)}{2\cos^2 x}$

$=\dfrac{\sin x\bigl(2\cos^2 x+2\cos^2 x-1+1\bigr)}{2\cos^2 x}$

$=2\sin x$

parts.working_md:
Construction: Draw $KO$ produced.

$\hat{O}_1=\hat{K}_1+\hat{T}$ [ext $\angle$ of $\triangle$]

But $\hat{K}_1=\hat{T}$ [$\angle$s opp equal sides]

$\therefore\hat{O}_1=2\hat{K}_1$

$\hat{O}_2=\hat{K}_2+\hat{P}$ [ext $\angle$ of $\triangle$]

But $\hat{K}_2=\hat{P}$ [$\angle$s opp equal sides]

$\therefore\hat{O}_2=2\hat{K}_2$

$\therefore\hat{O}_1+\hat{O}_2=2\hat{K}_1+2\hat{K}_2$

$=2(\hat{K}_1+\hat{K}_2)$

$\therefore T\hat{O}P=2\,T\hat{K}P$

alternatives.label: OR
alternatives.working_md:
Construction: Draw $KO$.

$\hat{T}=\hat{K}_1$ [$\angle$s opp. equal sides]

$\therefore K\hat{O}T=180^{\circ}-2\hat{K}_1$ [sum of $\angle$s of $\triangle KOT$]

$\hat{P}=\hat{K}_2$ [$\angle$s opp. equal sides]

$\therefore K\hat{O}P=180^{\circ}-2\hat{K}_2$ [sum of $\angle$s of $\triangle KOP$]

$T\hat{O}P=360^{\circ}-(K\hat{O}T+K\hat{O}P)$ [$\angle$s around a point]

$=360^{\circ}-\bigl((180^{\circ}-2\hat{K}_1)+(180^{\circ}-2\hat{K}_2)\bigr)$

$=2\hat{K}_1+2\hat{K}_2$

$=2(\hat{K}_1+\hat{K}_2)$

$\therefore T\hat{O}P=2\,T\hat{K}P$
